bulk_drag: STOKES algebraic equilibrium only; gamma cancels; no force injection
interpolation: unchanged validated trilinear; all 8 corners required
invalid_query_policy: hard error; no fallback or clamping
selection_policy: User section 17 takes precedence over generic largest-step statement in section 16: .5 is coarse diagnostic, select .25 if gates pass versus .125, else .125 if stable and independent reference gates pass. Never select .5 for production.
synthetic_dt_policy: Use each frozen field own measured U_MAX with common vascular dx. Do not use real U_MAX for the much faster synthetic affine field.

case_duration_policy.real_time_rule: ceil(frozen domain diagonal / real U_MAX to coarsest candidate steps), all candidates end at same physical time unless safety stop

output_policy: nearest integer stride for about 1000 records per particle, always initial/final/stop; <=2000 records when possible; no output-time timestep adjustment

geometry_search.candidate_rule: all valid trilinear cell centers sorted by descending local speed then ascending cell id
geometry_search.preflight_method: independent Python RK2 at C=.125, unmodified geometry and margins; choose first candidate reaching net displacement >=10dx, record all attempts; may block, never redraw
geometry_search.case5_packing: original diameter descending, ties source id; greedy first nonoverlapping safe cell in speed/id order; retain maximum count found by this deterministic pass, minimum3; do not invent bubbles

storage_density_role: LAMMPS atom_style sphere input placeholder only; never read by passive integrator and no force/mass integration
